summary.title: regex101: Online Regex Tester, Builder, Converter & Debugger
summary.one_liner: regex101 is an online tool for building, testing, and debugging regular expressions across multiple flavors, with real-time matching and explanations.
takeaways: regex101 lets you build, test, and debug regular expressions with real-time matches.
It supports multiple regex flavors, including PCRE2, JavaScript, and Python, according to the meta description.
Regexes can be converted between flavors and saved or shared as examples.
The page also advertises Text Pipelines for combining regex with built-in text operations and inspecting each step.
summary.summary: This is the landing page of regex101, a web-based regular expression tester. According to the meta description, it lets users build, test, debug, and convert regex across flavors such as PCRE2, JavaScript, and Python, with real-time matches and explanations, and save and share examples. The page text itself is mostly interface labels and a promotional line about Text Pipelines, so it offers few technical details beyond the listing and meta description.
